polymarket-mert-sniper v1.3.6

- Internal updates to Python scripts for improved logic and/or maintenance.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) updated to reflect the latest commands, settings, and usage.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- No user-facing feature or configuration changes.

Fail closed when the order book cannot be fetched. Previously printed 'book unavailable (proceeding with caution)' and traded anyway, bypassing the MIN_BOOK_DEPTH_USD thin-book gate at exactly the moment it mattered most. Now skips the market.

Fix inverted book read: sort the CLOB book before reading best bid/ask and before summing depth. The book returns bids LOW-HIGH and asks HIGH-LOW, so a raw [:5] slice summed the five levels FURTHEST from the touch - the MIN_BOOK_DEPTH_USD thin-book gate was measuring the back of the book.

Version 1.3.3

- Default expiry window increased from 2 minutes to 8 minutes.
- Optional news-recency veto guard added (off by default); skips trades on macro/news resolution markets within 30 seconds of key releases.
- Documentation updated to describe new expiry default and news veto behavior.
- Configuration table and usage instructions reflect new settings.
- Obsolete skill-card.md file removed.
SIM-2374: align tunable env-var names between clawhub.json and CONFIG_SCHEMA

Reframe opening to lead with method instead of 'snipe' verb. Inline quantitative bounding ($10 max, 60/40 split, 2-min window, 5 trades/run, dry-run default) into disclaimer line. Catalog-reshape Tier 2 step 3.
